name: vertical-thumbnail-slider

frames.best_why: Full landscape photo fills the stage with the matching thumbnail boxed in the side strip.

tagline: Tiny photo strip on the left drags a big picture up and down.
summary: A photo gallery where a tall column of small previews sits to the left of one large image. Clicking or dragging through the column moves the main photo, which scrolls vertically instead of sideways.
appearance: A wide photo fills most of a black stage. Down the left edge runs a thin column of seven small landscape thumbnails with rounded corners, separated by narrow gaps. The active thumbnail sits inside a light rounded outline that marks it out from the rest.
behaviour: The thumbnail column and the large frame move together on a vertical axis: dragging the strip or the photo scrolls to the next image, and the outgoing picture slides away top or bottom. The outline hops to whichever thumbnail is current.
demo_content: Seven Unsplash nature photos: a dark lake shore, a misty lake with bare trees, and a pink flower on a pale background.
search_phrases: vertical image carousel with side thumbnails
thumbnail strip next to large photo
click small preview to change picture
photo gallery scrolling up and down
gallery where thumbnails sit on the left
picture switcher with one big frame
use_when: A handful of images must share a compact block and still show one large preview at a time.
avoid_when: The demo caps the frame at 400px tall and hardcodes seven photo URLs inside the file.
customise: Photo URLs, order and count live in the component file; width and height are set by classes on the shared carousel wrappers, not by props.
weight_why: Seven images in one drag carousel; nothing runs while the page is idle.

a11y.note: Every image is labelled simply 'image', and there is no visible focus treatment or reduced-motion handling.

issues: Every photo in the source has the alt text 'image', so none is described.
polish_why: Tidy dark gallery with a clear active thumbnail; only the cramped thumbnails and 400px cap date it.
title: Vertical Thumbnail Slider
